summary: Periodic scoring/standing update gated by a countdown timer. Every expiry it iterates the active driver grid computing per-vehicle position-change gaps, runs a proximity/range check against the monitor, records enter/leave events into a progress-bar ring buffer, sorts drivers by standing, syncs the sorted order array, encodes order-change events, and calls pit-proximity detection sub_4D1730.

local_names.v4: proximity hit flag (1 when any driver is inside the range gate)
local_names.v6: PositionChangeMonitor result for the current driver
local_names.v8: monitor struct pointer returned by PositionChangeMonitor
local_names.v10: track-position pointer (current) used for the delta
local_names.v11: track-position pointer (previous) used for the delta
local_names.v19: progress-bar ring buffer head from dword_8AAE64
local_names.v25: ring buffer head for the order-change event
local_names.v21: order-changed flag across the sync loop

operations.description: Decrement the timer at offset 0x120 by dbl_8AFE98; when the result is at most 0.0, reset it to 1048576000 (0.25f) and run the update pass
For each driver i in [0, dword_5C329C), fetch the vehicle from dword_7C54F0[i] and call PositionChangeMonitor(vehicle + 12)
Branch on the vehicle's activity state (dword at vehicle+16448) combined with the monitor state at monitor+68: either set the gap field to flt_5EA3FC, zero it, or compute a real delta

Compute the position delta between two track-position pointers (monitor+268 and monitor+272), normalize by 1/sqrt(distance-squared) when non-zero, and project the result into the vehicle gap field at +16452

Proximity gate: compare the gap against the threshold at offset 0x100 minus the vehicle track length (sqrt of three squared position terms times 5.0), setting v4 when any driver falls inside the window

When the proximity hit flag differs from the byte at offset 0x104, advance the ring buffer at dword_8AAE64 (bounded by dword_83EE60 below 1023, stride 432) and encode a ProgressBarEventEncode event with the dbl_8AFEA0 timestamp: type 33 when entering proximity, type 34 when leaving
Build the standing-order byte array v38 by reading byte vehicle+18580 for each entry of dword_7C54F0
Sort the order array with sub_5890AA: use DriverSortComparator when dword_7C56A4 equals 7, otherwise DriverStandingComparator
Sync the sorted order bytes into the per-driver order array at offset 0x128 (byte per index) and flag any change

If the order changed, reset the update counter at offset 0x124 to 0 and encode a type-7 order-change event (ring head at dword_8AAE64 with dbl_8AFEA0 timestamp and count dword_5C329C + 12); otherwise increment the counter byte

Fill the order-change event payload: when there are no drivers write the negative float bit pattern -1082130432 into three ring floats, otherwise write three values looked up from flt_5F0780 indexed by the order byte times 4656
Copy the per-driver order bytes from offset 0x128 into the ring event payload starting at byte offset 20
Call sub_4D1730(this) for pit-proximity detection at the end of the update pass

clean_pseudocode: changed = any(order[i] != byte (this + 0x128 + i)); copy order into this + 0x128;
if (changed) { counter (this+0x124) = 0; encode order-change event; fill payload; }
